_note: Hand corrections applied after scoring, our own picks. foreverchanges' and Wowhead's Warrior sets were read as a cross-check signal, never copied. Top-level _groups ({group: {pin: {slot: entry}, alternates: {rankKey: [{itemId, reason}]}, enchants: {slot: {enchantId, reason}}}}) apply to every variant whose preset-weights.json entry lists that group: pins sit under the class's and variant's own; alternates are offered in that slot's ranked list (tag "alternate"), never picked; enchants are forced unless the variant sets its own. A top-level _excludeEnchants ([{enchantId, reason}]) is never picked by any preset. Per class, pin ({slot: entry}) applies to every variant unless the variant pins that slot itself. Per class: exclude ([{itemId, reason}], never picked for any variant of the class), and per variant: pin ({slot: {itemId, reason}}, forced pick; must be a candidate for the slot, and may need a profession the class can have trained by the level, never a reputation) and enchants ({slot: {enchantId, reason}}, enchantId null for none). The generator fails on an entry without a reason or an id it can't place. Per variant, alternates ({rankKey: [{itemId, reason}]}) work the same way.

trinket.reason: Minor Recombobulator (Engineering 140): on-use heal and polymorph dispel. The engineer's alternative to the pinned reputation/honor trinkets.
Gnomish Net-o-Matic Projector (Engineering 210, trainable by 20): a 10 s root. The engineer's alternative to the pinned reputation/honor trinkets.

feet.reason: Boots - Minor Speed: movement speed decides PvP fights; effects aren't scored, so the generator can't pick it.

main.reason: Weapon - Revelation: the caster weapon enchant (the next non-periodic spell after a non-crit gets +100% crit chance). Effect-only, so it scores 0; its formula has no source in our data, but foreverchanges lists it as learnable.

trinket2.reason: Minor Recombobulator (Engineering 140): its on-use 96-160 mana and 202-338 health (5 min) outweighs the +2 mp5 / +6 Spirit stat trinkets it replaces for a caster or healer, and use effects aren't scored. Trinket 1 stays the generator's best stat trinket. The side's requires line tells non-engineers.

trinket.reason: Dog Whistle: a tracking hound for 3 min (10 min cooldown) plus 5 Shadow Resistance; an extra damage source, offered rather than pinned because its value at 30 isn't measured.

trinket1.reason: Cursed Murloc Eye: its Equip shadow damage on every hit is worth more to a DPS Warrior than the +4 Stamina runes, but effects aren't scored.

trinket2.reason: Minor Recombobulator (Engineering 140): an on-use heal, the best second trinket at 30 for an engineer. The side's requires line tells non-engineers.

a.reason: Insignia of the Alliance: removes stuns, roots and slows, the core Warrior PvP trinket, no profession needed. Client ItemSparse gates it at PvP rank 2 (Corporal); whether Forever keeps the honor vendor rank isn't verified. Replaces Minor Recombobulator (Engineering).

h.reason: Insignia of the Horde: removes stuns, roots and slows, the core Warrior PvP trinket, no profession needed. Client ItemSparse gates it at PvP rank 2 (Grunt); whether Forever keeps the honor vendor rank isn't verified. Replaces Minor Recombobulator (Engineering).

a.reason: Talisman of Arathor (League of Arathor, Friendly; Arathi Basin): +6 Stamina and a 278-338 physical absorb, available at 28. Replaces Gnomish Net-o-Matic (Engineering 210).

h.reason: Defiler's Talisman (The Defilers, Friendly; Arathi Basin): +6 Stamina and a 278-338 physical absorb, available at 28. Replaces Gnomish Net-o-Matic (Engineering 210).

trinket1.reason: Minor Recombobulator (Engineering 140): an on-use self-heal for an engineer tank.

trinket2.reason: Rune of Duty: the same +4 Stamina as Rune of Perfection, with all-resistance instead of spell piercing, which a tank can use.

wrist.reason: Bracer - Stamina over Lesser Deflection: at 30 tanks are health-limited, not crit-immunity-limited; +5 Stamina over +5 Defense.

hands.reason: Gloves - Agility (+7) over Thick Armor Kit (+4 Stamina, +32 armor): close by our weights (4.9 vs 5.6, Agility's armor and threat unscored); taken on the foreverchanges signal, revisit with the tank weights.

feet.reason: Boots - Stamina (+5) over Thick Armor Kit (+4 Stamina, +32 armor): close by our weights (5.0 vs 5.6); taken on the foreverchanges signal, revisit with the tank weights.

_excludeEnchants.reason: 2H Weapon - Lesser Strength: its formula (249513) has no known source in our data, and foreverchanges marks it not known.
2H Weapon - Lesser Agility: its formula (249511) has no known source in our data, and foreverchanges marks it not known.
Bracer - Agility (+9): its formula (249488) has no known source in our data, and foreverchanges marks it not known.
Chest - Minor Stats: reads +2 at 70374 but is +1 in Classic and on foreverchanges' 70450 sheet; Lesser Stats is the safe +2.
Cloak - Defense: reads 60 armor at 70374 but was cut to 30 in 70450; Greater Defense keeps 60.
